content:
rachel (Finance): Quick announcement: we're launching a public billing ledger export and a new soft_rate_cap feature next month. Ledger = per-route, per-hour aggregated rows for easier reconciliation.

diego (Billing Eng): Ledger export will be a gzipped CSV available from Billing -> Exports. Header sample: invoice_id,org_id,period,route,hour_iso,tokens,unit_price_cents,charge_cents. No prompt text or embeddings included.

marta (Product): soft_rate_cap explained: allows short bursts above the published rate-limit by applying a variable surcharge and soft queuing for <=30s. Goal: fewer 429s for bursty workloads but clearer cost signals.

kevin (Support): Important: will this change dispute windows or create surprise charges? Customers care about predictability.

rachel (Finance): No change to dispute window (30 days). New surcharge lines are explicit on invoices as "soft_rate_cap_surcharge" with the per-event charge. We'll include a pre-billing preview in the console so customers can see last-7d potential surcharge.

samir (Sales): Pricing nuance: can we offer buffer-free tiers for Reserved/Dedicated customers? Field needs playbook.

rachel (Finance): Reserved customers get configurable soft_cap thresholds via account manager; default self-serve gets the standard tiered surcharge.

diego (Billing Eng): Dev notes: feature flag + phased rollout, ledger generation as a background job writing to org-specific S3 with 90-day retention. CSV rows are hourly aggregates to limit size.

marta (Product): UX: toggle for "Enable soft rate cap" in Billing Settings and a checkbox for "Show ledger export". Both default ON for new orgs, OFF for existing orgs to avoid noise.

kevin (Support): Draft support blurb: "We've added a billing ledger CSV and an optional soft-rate-cap that reduces 429s for short bursts in exchange for explicit surcharge lines. No changes to base rate-limits or dispute policy."

ops-bot: deploy started: billing-ledger-service:v1.0.0 -> canary (7%) 

diego (Billing Eng): We also added a per-route unit-pricing table in the console so customers see price bands (e.g., 0-1M tokens = 0.02c/token, 1M-10M = 0.015c/token). This helps forecasting.

rachel (Finance): Communication plan: blog post + KB with sample ledger + console banner 14/7/1 days before opt-in migration. We'll run a 2-week internal pilot and then open to self-serve.

marta (Product): Legal reviewed privacy impact: OK. No user content included. Compliance ok with standard DPA.

ops-bot: deploy success: billing-ledger-service:v1.0.0 canary healthy (2026-03-23T21:10:03Z)

samir (Sales): Field note: attach one-pager and sample invoice lines to Renewal pack.

kevin (Support): I'll create canned responses and a short playbook for refunds/refunds-if-surcharge-erroneous.

diego (Billing Eng): Metric watchlist: ledger generation time, S3 egress, %orgs enabling soft_rate_cap, surcharge volume, dispute spike.

rachel (Finance): Final customer-facing sentence (draft): "New: billing ledger export for transparent per-route usage and an optional soft rate cap to reduce burst errors — with clear surcharges and in-console previews." Feedback welcome.

marta (Product): Loves it. :rocket:

rachel (Finance): Launching pilot invites tomorrow 09:00 PT. If you want to be on the internal beta, DM me.
